name: Nexus Server
author: lioner2008@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Nexus social server: accounts, text chat, voice/video call signaling and a built-in TURN relay for the Nexus game launcher.

The server listens on the primary allocation (SERVER_PORT).
- Optional TURN relay: UDP TURN_PORT (default 3478) and UDP relay ports RELAY_MIN-RELAY_MAX (default 49160-49200)

Allocate the UDP ports to the server and set PUBLIC_IP to the node's public address so calls work across networks.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nexus Server installation
cd /home/container
mkdir -p nexus-data
chown -R container:container /home/container 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Nexus Server installed. Set the variables, then start the server."

variables.name: Invite code
variables.description: Code friends need when creating an account (--invite). Leave empty to allow open registration – not recommended when the server is reachable from the internet.

variables.name: Enable TURN relay
variables.description: Switch: on (1) starts the built-in TURN relay so voice/video calls work even behind strict NATs. Requires the UDP ports TURN_PORT and RELAY_MIN-RELAY_MAX to be allocated to this server. Off (0) = signaling only (calls only work peer-to-peer).

variables.name: TURN port
variables.description: UDP port of the TURN relay. Must match an allocated UDP port (default 3478).

variables.name: Relay port range min
variables.description: First UDP relay port (--relay-min). Each simultaneous relayed stream needs one port. Must match the allocated UDP ports.

variables.name: Relay port range max
variables.description: Last UDP relay port (--relay-max). Must match the allocated UDP ports and be at least RELAY_MIN.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Public IP or hostname of this server (--public-ip), used by the TURN relay. Leave empty to auto-detect – inside Docker the detected address is usually wrong, so set the node's public IP here.
